image_url.description: URL of the product image to be processed.

size.description: Apparent emitter size/softness. Higher = softer penumbra. Leave unset to auto-estimate the light from the image.

x.description: Horizontal light position, normalized to image center (-1 to 1). Leave unset to auto-estimate the light from the image.

y.description: Vertical light position, normalized to image center (-1 to 1). Leave unset to auto-estimate the light from the image.

z.description: Height above subject (0 to 2). Leave unset to auto-estimate the light from the image.

light_source.description: Virtual light used to synthesize the shadow. When omitted, the light direction is estimated from the image.

generative.description: Params for the generative AI shadow (used when shadow.type = 'generative').

horizontal.description: Horizontal shadow offset strength (-100 to 100). Positive moves the shadow right, negative moves it left. 100 is the maximum offset, 10% of the canvas width.

blur.description: Shadow blur strength (0 to 100). 0 is a hard-edged shadow; 100 is the softest, a radius of 5% of the smaller canvas dimension.

vertical.description: Vertical shadow offset strength (-100 to 100). Positive moves the shadow down, negative moves it up. 100 is the maximum offset, 10% of the canvas height.

color.description:
RGB color. `RGBColor` is the FAL naming convention that renders the color-picker
swatch. The per-field default (e.g. white for the background) is carried on each field
below; note the playground swatch initializes to black regardless (a FAL UI quirk — it
ignores the field-level default), but the server honors the field default.

drop.description:
Params for the deterministic drop shadow (used when shadow.type = 'drop'),
mirroring the web editor's drop shadow (offset + blur + color + opacity).

type.description: Shadow style: 'Generative' (generative AI shadow) or 'Drop' (deterministic drop shadow). Leave unset for no shadow.

shadow.description:
Shadow control: leave `type` unset for no shadow, or select 'generative' (AI) or
'drop' (deterministic); set its params in the matching nested object.

image_url.description: Logo/watermark image URL. If empty, no watermark is added.

scale.description: Watermark width as a fraction of the canvas width.

margin.description: Inset from the edge. '%' (0–49%) of the canvas, or 'px'.

remove_background.description: Remove the watermark image's own background (via background removal) before overlaying it.

anyOf.description: A logo/watermark image overlaid on top of the output.

watermark.description: Optional logo/watermark image overlaid on top of the output. Off by default; omit for no watermark.

height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.description: The width of the generated image.

image_size.description: Output canvas size. A preset (square_hd, square, portrait_4_3, portrait_16_9, landscape_4_3, landscape_16_9) or a custom {width, height}. Defaults to square_hd (1024x1024).

mode.description: 'Color' fills with `color` (white by default); 'Transparent' leaves it transparent (always PNG); 'Image' composites onto `image_url`.

image_fit.description: How the background image fills the canvas: 'Cover' fills and crops, 'Contain' fits and letterboxes onto `color`, 'Stretch' distorts to fit.

image_url.description: Background image URL. Required when mode is 'Image'.

color.description:
RGB color. `RGBColor` is the FAL naming convention that renders the color-picker
swatch. The per-field default (e.g. white for the background) is carried on each field
below; note the playground swatch initializes to black regardless (a FAL UI quirk — it
ignores the field-level default), but the server honors the field default.

background.description: Output background: a solid color, transparent, or a background image.

output_format.description: The format of the resultant image (PNG or JPEG). When not set, matches the input format. JPEG cannot be combined with a transparent background.

all.description: Margin applied to all sides. '%' (0–49%) of the canvas dimension, or 'px' (>=0px).

margin.description:
Canvas margin around the product. `all` applies to every side; a per-side value
overrides `all` for that side. Each value is '%' (0–49%) of the canvas, or 'px' (>=0px).
